fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (WMT) is currently trading at $127.52 with a P/E of 46x based on past four-quarter net income, a level only surpassed in three of 31 past earnings releases.
fields.summary_ko.1: Of 31 earnings releases since February 1992, high P/E (40x or above) periods averaged 1.7% decline, while low P/E (below 40x) averaged 0.7% gain, with all three 2026 quarters at P/E of 40x or above recording 1.4-9.2% declines.
fields.summary_ko.2: The maximum drawdown of 11.4% in May 2022 occurred at a mid-level P/E (30.4x), indicating that high P/E does not necessarily mean large declines, though high P/E shows a higher frequency of declines.
